title: GIT for root stacks and 3d mirror symmetry
summary: Using window theory, Bodzenta--Donovan showed that the derived category of a root stack $\sqrt[n]{X/D}$ has a $2n$-periodic $2$-term semiorthogonal decomposition. We define a categorical generalization of the root stack construction and interpret this as a pullback on the B-side of the 3d mirror symmetry equivalence of Gammage--Hilburn--Mazel-Gee. We analyze this pullback using categorical representation theoretic results of Ben-Zvi--Francis--Nadler and Ben-Zvi--Nadler--Preygel applied to SODs. We also show that the pullback is equivalent to a pushforward of perverse schobers on the A-side,…
